content: Jesus Makes a Leper Clean
Pu pam tsomoṅaqw hawhq, sinom qaan’ewakw hintaqam put aṅkya.
Noqw meh, hak tokoplelet tūtuyhqa pituhqe, put aw naokiway’taqe aw paṅqawu: Tutuyqawhqa, um suhtaq’ewnen soon nuy qa powatani.
Noqw Jesus put aw māvuyaltiqe aw toṅokt paṅqawu: Pay nu suhtaq’ewa; powaltii. Noqw pahsat pay put aṅ tokoplele súlawhti.

Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Um hapi qa hakiy aw haqam lavayhtini; pay um ahpiynen God awwat moṅwit aw nāmahtaknani, nen Moses hin tutaptaqw um kuwahtiput God aw nóani. Um yan powaltiqey nuhtumi tuawi’tani.
Jesus Heals a Roman Officer’s Servant
Noqw Jesus Capernaum aw pakiqw, hak solāwamuy amumi moṅwi put aw pituhqe, put aw qa nātusitaqe,
Paṅqawu: Tutuyqawhqa, ihoṅviaya ikiy ep tuyhqatsq, put ahpa’ qatāyuṅqw, pam pas k̇ānanvotk̇aṅw okiwhinta.
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Pay nu aqwnen put qalaptsinani.
Noqw solāwamoṅwi lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: Tutuyqawhqa, soon pi um nuy yan’ewakwniqw ikiy aw papkini. Pay um panis lavayhtiqw, pay ihoṅviaya qalaptuni.

Pi nu sukwat aw maqaptsi’k̇aṅw qatu. Noqw solāwam inumi piw maqaptsi’yuṅwa. Noqw nu sukw aw, Yupa, kitaqw pam haqaminiṅwu; pu sukwat aw, Pew’i, kitaqw pam inuminiṅwu; pu ituwikiy aw, Yanhtii, kitaqw pam panhtiṅwu.
Noqw Jesus put navotqe pas aw k̇ātaytaqe put aṅkyaqamuy amumi paṅqawu: Nu umumi pas antsa paṅqawni: Pas nu qa haqam pas yan tuptsiwnit tuwa, hikis Israel‐sinmuy amuhpee.
Noqw nu umumi paṅqawni: Nāt k̇aysiwhqam hōpaqw, pu tavaṅqw ökini; nen Abraham, pu Isaac, pu Jacob, pumuy amumum ōveqatsit ep tunösvoñat aw yesvani.
Noqw ima as paṅsoq yuṅniqam ihpo qatalpumi maspiwyani. Pep pu’ tsaykitiwni, pu tama ṅuritiwni.
Noqw Jesus solāwamoṅwit aw paṅqawu: Pay pi um aqwni. Pay um hin tuptsiwhq nam antaa. Noqw put hoṅviayaat pay pahsatniqw qalaptu.
Jesus Heals Many People
Pu Jesus Peter kīyat aw pakiqw kurs put nȫmayat yuat mukituyat akw tuyhqatsi.
Noqw Jesus put māyat aw toṅokq, mukituya put mātavi; noqw wuhti qatuptuqe pumuy amumi unaṅwtavi.
Noqw tapkiqw, sinom k̇aysiwhqamuy nukpanhihikwsimuy akw tuyqawiwyuṅqamuy put aw tsamvaya; noqw pam lavayiy akw sinmuy amuṅaqw nukpanhihikwsimuy ipwa; nihqe sohsokmuy tūtuyyaqamuy qalaptsina.
Yan Tutuyqawhqat lavay’ayayat Esaias lavayiat aw antsaniwa, pam ura paṅqawu: Pam itamuy hihta akw ȫpuiwyuṅqat nāmi nahlaknak̇aṅw, itahtuyay īkwilta.
The Would‐Be Followers of Jesus
Noqw Jesus sinmuy qaan’ewakw hintaqamuy put aw ṅöyakiwtaqw túwahqe, put aw nánatuwnayaqamuy wuhkovatuphat yupqöymiyaniqat amumi paṅqawu.
Noqw hak tutavot tūtutuqaynaqa Jesus aw pítuhqe put aw paṅqawu: Tūtutuqaynaqa, nu uṅ haqaminiqw úmummantani.
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Ima sisik̇ahtayht haqe’ qölöy’yuṅwa, noqw súmawuy aṅ masay’yuṅqam totokpi’yuṅwa; noqw nu’ Sinot Tiat haqam iqötöy nāsuṅwnaniqey ṅastaa.
Pu piw suhk̇a put aw nánatuwnaqa put aw paṅqawu: Tutuyqawhqa, um nuy nakwhanaqw, nu mohti inay amht, pu’ uṅkni.
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Um inuṅkni; ason pi so’pum pumuy amuṅaqw so’pumuy amyani.
Jesus Calms a Storm
Pu pam pākihut aqw pakiqw, put aw nánatuwnayaqam put aṅk aqw yuṅa.
Noqw meh, wuhkovatuphat aṅqe’ qaan’ewakw hukvaqe, pas qaöwíhuhukq, ōviy pākihut pāhut hoṅvantaqat akw nȫmilti; noqw pantaqw Jesus pūwi.
Noqw put aw nánatuwnayaqam put aw ökihqe, tātaynayaqe aw paṅqaqwa: Tutuyqawhqa, itamuy ayo óyaa; itam súlawhtini.
Noqw pam pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Ya uma hinoqw pas tsawiniwyuṅwa, okiw uma öwituptsiwni’yuṅqamu? Pahsat pu pam wunuptut, hūhuk̇aṅwtuy mēwa, pu pāhuta. Noqw wukosutmakma.
Noqw tuwat tahtaqt k̇atayuṅqe paṅqaqwa: Ya sen i’ hak himuniqw, ōviy hikis pi hūhuk̇aṅw, pu pāhu put hiṅqawhq anhtoti?
Jesus Heals Two Men with Demons

Noqw pam wuhkovatuphat ayoqwat Gergese‐sinmuy tutskwayamuy aw pituqw, pepeq hakim lȫyöm tāqatuy nukpanhihikwsimuy akw tuyqawiwtaqamuy tuamaqölṅaqw yámakqe, put ahsawva; hakim nuhtsel’ewayomniqw, ōviy soon hak paṅqe’ hinnumni.
Noqw meh, puma a’nö töqtiqe paṅqawu: Ya um itamuy hinhtiniqat nāwakna Jesus, um God Táita? Ya um nāt aw qa pituqw pay itamuy okiwsanniqe ōviy pitu?
Noqw pep pumuy amuṅaqw yāp pitsōtim wukotonawtaqam nōnova.
Noqw ōviy nukpanhihikwsim put aw ö’qalyaqe paṅqaqwa: Kurs um itamuy ipwe’, itamuy pitsōtimuy amumi yuṅniqat itamuy nakwhanani.
Noqw pam amumi paṅqawu: Yúpave. Noqw puma nöṅakqe, pitsōtimuy amumi yuña. Noqw sohsoyam pitsōtim tuhpelat aṅ pāmiq a’nö yuhtukqe, pāmiq paöysoa.
Noqw pumuy nopni’yuṅqam watqaqe, kīmiyaqe, hin hiniwhtiqat lavayhta, pu ima hakim nukpanhihikwsimuy akw tuyqawiwtaqam hin hinhtiqata.
Noqw sohsoyam pep kitsókit ep ki’yuṅqam paṅqw Jesus ahsawvawisa; nihqe put tutwaqe pay pam pumuy tutskwayamuy aṅqw ahpiyniqat put aw ö’qalya.
